blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: When a user supplies a document and wants the answer drawn from it, a language model is expected to follow it even when it contradicts its parametric knowledge. Prior work has focused on making the model rely on context by steering activations, contrasting logits during decoding, or instructing it in plain language. We ask whether the document alone, with no instruction written into it and no access to the model at inference time, is enough. We optimize a document suffix by discrete token search, starting from the answer to a single question and extending the objective to a set of passages, to multi-hop questions that follow from the planted fact, and to later turns of a conversation. On counterfactual passages that contradict parametric knowledge of the model, the suffix flips nearly all items the model resists across three instruction-tuned model families, in most settings outperforms the decoding baseline and the strongest instruction we could write, and matches activation steering. Controls show that the suffix largely acts through the passage rather than injecting the answer, and a single suffix per model transfers to unseen passages. Each extended objective carries the effect to its target, so the objective, not only the document, sets how far the effect reaches.
blocks.zh: 当一个用户提供一个文档并想要从中提取的答案时,一个语言模型即使与它的参数化知识相矛盾,也有望遵循它. 之前的工作重点是通过引导活化,在解码时对比日志,或用平话指示来使模型依赖上下文. 我们问,仅凭该文件本身,没有写入任何指示,也没有在推断时间获得模型是否足够。 我们通过离散的符号搜索来优化一个文档后缀,从回答到一个单一的问题,然后将目标扩展到一组段落,从所植入的事实开始的多跳问题,再到后来的对话转折. 在与模型的参数化知识相矛盾的反事实段落上,后缀翻转了几乎所有的模型所抵抗的项目,跨越了三个指令调制的模型家族,在大多数情况下,都超过了解码基线和我们所能写的最强指令,并匹配活化向导. 控制显示后缀主要通过通道进行操作,而不是将答案注入,每个模型都有一个后缀向看不见的通道转移. 每个扩大的目标都带来其目标的效果,因此目标,而不仅仅是文件,规定了效果达到的程度。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Language models are increasingly used in settings where they receive, as
context, documents that were not in their training data. Whether the document
updates, corrects or contradicts what the model holds, the model is expected
to answer from the document rather than from what it knows. When the document
contradicts the model’s parametric knowledge, however, it does not always
follow. Asked who develops macOS, a model answers Apple , and it keeps
answering Apple even when given a passage stating that macOS is developed
by the BBC ( Figure 1 ). We study such passages because they are a
hard and measurable case: the model’s own answer and the passage’s answer are
distinct and known in advance, and models are aligned to reject claims they
hold to be false.

blocks.en:
Existing methods for making a model follow its context intervene inside the
model at inference time. Context-aware decoding contrasts logits computed
with and without the context at every generation step ( Shi et al., 2024 ) , and Minder et al. (2025) steer the
residual stream toward the context on every forward pass. The alternative on
the context side is to write an instruction such as Answer based on the
context into the document itself, but whether the model complies is left to
its instruction-following, and the effect varies widely with phrasing and
across models. How far a model can be made to follow its context by shaping
the document, rather than by asking the model, remains unknown.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
When context contradicts parametric knowledge, models often fall back on
memory ( Longpre et al., 2021 ) , and whether they yield depends on how
coherent and convincing the evidence is ( Xie et al., 2024 ) .
Context-aware decoding ( Shi et al., 2024 ) contrasts the output distributions with and without the context, up-weighting tokens that the context makes more likely. Minder et al. (2025) find a direction in the residual stream of
three language models that can be used to steer the model toward its context
or toward its parametric knowledge, applied at every forward pass. Hagström et al. (2026) systematically compare such context manipulation
techniques, including under knowledge conflict. Unlike decoding and steering
methods, our suffix does not require access to the model at inference time
and sits in a fixed slot inside the context, which lets us measure how far
context following reaches beyond the inputs it was optimized on.

blocks.en:
Zou et al. (2025) inject passages into the knowledge base that are
retrieved for a target question and state an attacker-chosen answer, written
as prose by a language model; we author neither, keeping the passage fixed
and targeting its factual content. They also evaluate a GCG baseline,
optimized on a surrogate model since their attacker cannot query the target,
and find it fails because the result is never retrieved. Other injection
attacks hide a natural-language command in content the model reads, or
optimize the trigger that activates one ( Chaudhari et al., 2025 ; Greshake et al., 2023 ; Pasquini et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024b ) .
In all of these the document states what the model should do, whereas our
suffix carries no command, and all are evaluated end to end on questions the
model may or may not hold parametric knowledge of; we set retrieval aside and
isolate the generation step, on items where the model holds the true fact
and rejects the passage.

blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en:
We study the simplest setting in which context and parametric knowledge
compete: a single passage, simulating a document that a user pastes or a
retriever returns, is given directly in the user context without any system
prompt. We use no retriever and no competing documents, as a full RAG system would,
because we need the change in the answer to be attributable to the passage. The prompt is
therefore the passage, the suffix, and the question

We use two datasets. BaseFakepedia ( Monea et al., 2024 ) is the
counterfactual dataset used by Minder et al. (2025) . Each item
pairs a passage asserting a false fact about a real entity with a cloze
query that the false fact answers, as in Figure 1 . Its passages
are written to assert the planted fact throughout, so nothing in them
points at the true answer. CUB NQ ( Hagström et al., 2026 ) is built
from real retrieved web text, with one entity replaced in the first
mention. The rest of the passage is untouched, so it still describes the
true entity, which makes these passages shorter but internally
inconsistent. Figure 2 details one item from each.

when the passage contradicts the vanilla model output, so for each model we
retain only items where the model (based on a single greedy pass): (i) does not give the passage’s answer without the passage, whether in the form of a different answer or declining to answer; and (ii) still does not give it with the passage present and no suffix ( Appendix E ). We additionally remove items with defects in the passage, such as passages that never assert the counterfactual or that debunk themselves

resulting sets differ by model: 248 / 254 / 180 items on BaseFakepedia and
152 / 56 / 129 on CUB NQ for Llama, Mistral and Gemma. The flip rate (= the proportion of items where the answer changes from the model’s own to
the one the passage supplies) without a suffix is 0.000 on every set by

strategies that work against refusal in the jailbreaking literature ( Zeng et al., 2024 ) , on the premise that a model resisting a
counterfactual passage behaves like a model refusing a request. Each is
placed in the suffix slot inside the combined prompt and asks for a one-word
answer; all ten are listed in Appendix C . We report the best of
the ten per model, chosen after seeing its score on the evaluation set,
making this an oracle baseline with access to information our method does
not get. The worst of the ten is a

within 0.02 and trade places. Context-aware decoding ( Shi et al., 2024 ) uses the best

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
Our results show that a 20-token optimized suffix inside a context passage
makes a language model answer with the document’s fact that contradicts its
parametric knowledge, in most settings more reliably than natural-language
instructions. It outperforms context-aware decoding on all three models and
matches activation steering, which reads and modifies the model’s activations
at every generation step, and our controls show it works through the document
rather than instead of it. The objective can be fitted to one sample, several
passages, multi-hop questions, or later turns. The suffix is therefore best
described as steering how a document is weighed on the forward passes it was
optimized for, rather than as changing what the model answers in general. We
propose multi-hop and repeated questions as a check on any method that claims
to make a model follow its context.

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en:
Our suffix makes a language model answer with a claim stated in a document,
including a false one. A user could use this to make a model accept new or
corrected information, but an adversary could equally use it to make a model
repeat misinformation planted in a document.

包括一个虚假的。 一个用户可以用它来让模型接受新的或者
但是对手也可以用它做模型
重复在文档中安装的错误信息。

blocks.en:
We judge publication to be the right choice for three reasons. The primitive
it relies on, discrete token search against an open-weight model, is already
public ( Zou et al., 2023 ) . The setting is one defenders need to
understand, since the same decision between context and parametric knowledge
determines whether legitimate retrieved evidence is used at all. And the
paper supplies the measurements a defense would be evaluated against: a floor
that is zero by construction, controls that separate a real effect from
answer injection, and a scoring procedure that does not credit an answer the
model retracts.

The target { ck } because costs the same two tokens as the reported

Zou et al. (2023) chose Sure, here is because an aligned model
commits to a mode in its first tokens. We looked for the analogous prefix
here and found none. On items where the best instruction flips the model,
its probability mass lands almost entirely on answer position 0, and the
token it lifts is the first subword of the planted answer itself ( + 0.72 +0.72 to + 0.94 +0.94 ); later positions lift by approximately zero. Without the suffix
the model does open with a refusal ( I’m afraid that’s a mistake ), but
the instruction does not replace it with a compliance register: it raises P ⁡ ( ck ) P(\textsf{ck}) so the refusal never starts. On free-form prompts the same
probe inverts, with the median position of maximum lift at 15 and the
planted token first appearing at median position 22, which is why a prefix
objective cannot reach it.
